title: Kanade–Russell's cylindric partition profile conjecture
statement:
Let $k\geq 3$, let $c=(c_1,c_2,c_3)$ be a cylindric partition profile with $|c|+3=m=3k+\{-1,0,1\}$, and, using cyclic symmetries, assume $c_1\geq c_2,c_3$. Let $H_{(c_1,c_2,c_3)}(z,q)$ denote the associated generating function, and let $e_i$ and $\delta_i$ be the vectors defined by

$$
e_i=(\underbrace{0,0,\dots,0}_{i},1,1,\dots,1),\qquad \delta_i=(\delta_{ij})_{1\leq j\leq k-1}.
$$

For $m\in\{3k-1,3k,3k+1\}$, let $S_m(z;\rho\mid\sigma)$ be the corresponding multiple-sum functions defined for integer vectors $\rho,\sigma\in\mathbb Z^{k-1}$. **Kanade–Russell's conjecture.** If $c_2,c_3\leq k-1$, then

$$
H_{(c_1,c_2,c_3)}(z,q)=\begin{cases}S_m(z;e_{c_2}\mid e_{c_3})-qS_m(z;e_{c_2-1}\mid e_{c_3-1}),&c_2,c_3>0,\\S_m(z;e_{c_2}\mid e_0),&c_3=0,\\S_m(z;e_0\mid e_{c_3})-q(1-z)S_m(z;e_0+\delta_0\mid e_{c_3-1}),&c_2=0,\ c_3\ne0.
\end{cases}
$$

This is the principal cylindric Kanade–Russell conjecture for the three-part profiles; the paper develops proofs for the modulo $11$ and $13$ cases, while the general fixed-$k$ assertion is the conjectural framework motivating those results.
source_name: Ali Kemal Uncu, “Proofs of Modulo 11 and 13 Cylindric Kanade-Russell Conjectures for A_2 Rogers-Ramanujan Type Identities”, arXiv:2301.01359 (2023).
references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2018–2023). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2211.12351](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.12351), [arXiv:1808.01432](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.01432).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.01359

Status: **open** according to the source (as of January 2023). “Finally we transferred the open problems into a linear algebra setting, and we can approach it as such.”
